name: _viewer.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_viewer.scss — the file viewer — translucent reading surface over the 3D scene.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  // ── File viewer — translucent reading surface over the scene ─────────
  &-viewer {
    pointer-events: auto;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-md);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 93%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-viewer-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &-viewer-back {
    background: none;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  &-viewer-path {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.7;
    word-break: break-all;
  }
}
